items.title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift
items.excerpt: ByteDance Seed's Seedream 5.5 targets production workflows: stable multi-pass editing up to 100 iterations, native RGBA output with transparent backgrounds, rolling out across Dreamina and CapCut.
items.rationale: New image-model release aimed squarely at production editing: 100-round edits without color drift plus native RGBA/transparent output change how designers iterate on assets.

items.title: Is ArtStation's new AI art policy good enough?
items.excerpt: ArtStation's new rules for AI-generated art try to balance artist protection and disclosure; Creative Bloq weighs whether the policy goes far enough for working creatives.
items.rationale: New disclosure/labeling rules on the main portfolio platform for concept artists and 3D designers directly affect how they post and present work (assigned to design by the run brief).

items.title: Siemens adds agentic AI to HyperLynx verification workflows
items.excerpt: Siemens' new agentic toolkit lets PCB designers run SerDes, DDR, signal- and power-integrity analysis in HyperLynx from natural-language prompts.
items.rationale: Concrete product release: natural-language agents driving SI/PI verification in HyperLynx, a different tool and workflow from the 10-25 Siemens 3D IC card.

items.title: AI prototyping inside your design system: a hands-on guide for design & product teams
items.excerpt: Why AI builders hand back a lookalike instead of your real components, what has to exist in a design system before an agent can use it, and the MCP setup the author uses for in-system prototyping.
items.rationale: Highly actionable: a checklist of what a design system needs before agents can prototype with real components, plus a concrete MCP setup teams can copy tomorrow.

items.title: Config India 2026: What changed when designers started shipping code
items.excerpt: Freshworks' Sascha Trinkaus on connecting its design system to code so designers can ship, and what happens when they ship faster than teams can judge the ideas.
items.rationale: Fresh Config India case study from a large product org (Freshworks) on designers shipping code, including the downside of shipping faster than teams can evaluate ideas.
